last_review.summary: The change satisfies AUTH-004-A and complies with the architecture and Prisma safety constraints. It adds a lifecycle-managed Prisma boundary using validated DATABASE_URL, implements a read-only user_info lookup by trusted user ID, preserves all nullable identity fields, registers the repository correctly, stays within allowed paths, and passes both TypeScript build and Prisma validation.

notes: No tests are executed by loop V2.
Do not connect autonomous agents to the production Supabase database.
Core does not exist yet; Auth defines stable seams/contracts but does not implement Core.
Auth->Core internal request auth is Noop in V1; future signed JWT is a pluggable strategy.
